goal: Harden COS Graph Engine deterministic identity so canonical serialization accepts only plain JSON-like values, rejects ambiguous or executable object forms, and normalizes Unicode to NFC without expanding into provider case rules or registry immutability.
acceptance: Only plain JSON-like canonical serializer inputs are accepted.
Unicode strings, object keys, authority, resource type, and resource IDs normalize to NFC.
Executable accessors and ambiguous array/object forms are rejected.
Regression tests cover every declared canonical boundary.
Planner, Builder, Test Engineer, Security Reviewer, and Code Reviewer are independent roles.
No agent receives Git write or merge authority.
